N - the numeric type: Integer, Long, Float, or Double
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named
public final class NumberSetting<N extends Number & Comparable<N>> extends Setting<N>
A bounded numeric value, rendered as a slider.

Bounds and step are enforced in coerce(N), so a value out of range cannot enter the setting from the GUI, a command, or a hand-edited config.
